evidence_policy: Provider advertised fees and association self-reported transaction-rate summaries are observed price evidence. No quote was requested and no transaction or buyer acceptance was observed. A total formed by hourly rate times estimated scope is an estimate, not an observed job price. Human service providers may use conventional automation or AI; absence of AI use is not established unless explicitly stated.

freeze_recommendation.accounting: Subtract provider review/support/onboarding/failures/allocated setup/maintenance/obligations/reserves before reinvestment; retain customer effort separately; no token transfers as receipts
freeze_recommendation.claim_limit: Price-anchored conditional modeled advantage is possible without observed demand; no guaranteed adoption, human-only superiority over all providers, or superiority to other AI systems follows
